topPRs.title: fix: TypeScript build errors blocking postinstall (Bun globals + parseUsage type mismatch)
topPRs.author: andex23
topPRs.body:
## Summary `tsc --project tsconfig.build.json` currently fails on a fresh clone with 4 errors, which cascades into `bun install` failing in any consumer repo that builds all workspace packages on postinstall (e.g. milady). ``` init.ts(39,24): error TS2868: Cannot find name 'Bun'. utils/claude-cli.ts(83,16): error TS2868: Cannot find name 'Bun'. utils/claude-cli.ts(142,16): error TS2868: Cannot find name 'Bun'. utils/claude-cli.ts(208,28): error TS2345: Argument of type '{ inputTokens: number; outputTokens: number; totalTokens: number; }' is not assignable to parameter of type '{ promptTokens: number; completionTokens: number; totalTokens: number; }'. ``` ## Fix - **`Cannot find name 'Bun'`** — `tsconfig.json` declares `types: ["node", "bun"]`, but `@types/bun` is a globals-augmentation package (not a module) and TS doesn't always resolve it through workspace hoisting depending on the consumer's resolver settings. Added a local `declare const Bun: any;` in the two files that touch `Bun.spawn` / `Bun.spawnSync`. This keeps the existing bun fast-path working without forcing every consumer to wire `@types/bun` themselves. - **`parseUsage` → `resolveUsage` type mismatch** (`claude-cli.ts:208`) — `parseUsage()` returns `{ inputTokens, outputTokens, totalTokens }` but `resolveUsage` is typed as `{ promptTokens, completionTokens, totalTokens }`. The same object was already being mapped correctly for `emitModelUsageEvent` two lines above; this PR reuses that mapping for `resolveUsage` too. ## Test plan - [x] `tsc --project tsconfig.build.json` exits 0 on a fresh clone - [x] `bun install` postinstall completes downstream (verified in milady consumer repo) - [ ] Existing tests still pass (no behavior change — type-only fix + dropped a duplicate field-mapping)

Greptile Summary

This PR fixes four TypeScript build errors that blocked `tsc --project tsconfig.build.json` on fresh clones. It adds `declare const Bun: any;` ambient declarations to the two files that call `Bun.spawn`/`Bun.spawnSync`, and fixes a field-name mismatch where `resolveUsage` was being called with `{ inputTokens, outputTokens }` instead of the expected `{ promptTokens, completionTokens }` shape — a real runtime bug that would have caused consumers of the `usagePromise` to receive fields with the wrong names.

Confidence Score: 5/5

Safe to merge — all changes are type-only fixes or a correct field-name alignment with no behavior regressions. Both fixes are narrowly scoped: the `declare const Bun` declarations compile to nothing at runtime, and the `resolveUsage` field-name fix corrects a genuine bug (wrong property names on the resolved promise) without altering any control flow. No P0 or P1 issues identified. No files require special attention.

Important Files Changed

| Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | typescript/init.ts | Adds `declare const Bun: any;` ambient declaration between import statements to resolve TS2868 compile error; no logic changes. | | typescript/utils/claude-cli.ts | Adds `declare const Bun: any;` to fix TS2868, and extracts `tokenUsage` to correctly pass `{ promptTokens, completionTokens, totalTokens }` to both `emitModelUsageEvent` and `resolveUsage`, fixing the TS2345 type mismatch and a real field-name bug in the resolved usage promise. |

Sequence Diagram

```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Caller participant streamViaCli participant Bun participant parseUsage participant emitModelUsageEvent participant resolveUsage Caller->>streamViaCli: call(runtime, prompt, modelName, ...) streamViaCli->>Bun: Bun.spawn(args, {stdout,stderr}) Bun-->>streamViaCli: proc loop stream-json lines streamViaCli->>streamViaCli: yield text_delta chunks end Note over streamViaCli,resolveUsage: On result event (BEFORE fix: wrong shape) streamViaCli->>parseUsage: parseUsage(event.modelUsage) parseUsage-->>streamViaCli: { inputTokens, outputTokens, totalTokens } Note over streamViaCli,resolveUsage: AFTER fix: map to tokenUsage first streamViaCli->>streamViaCli: tokenUsage = { promptTokens, completionTokens, totalTokens } streamViaCli->>emitModelUsageEvent: emitModelUsageEvent(runtime, modelType, prompt, tokenUsage) streamViaCli->>resolveUsage: resolveUsage(tokenUsage) resolveUsage-->>Caller: Promise resolves with correct field names ``` Reviews (1): Last reviewed commit: ["fix: build errors in plugin-anthropic bl..."](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/commit/a9ec7d1cb0d31d63d7889b0310417c143bc92966) | [Re-trigger Greptile](https://app.greptile.com/api/retrigger?id=30176864) ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **Bug Fixes** * Improved token usage tracking and reporting accuracy in streaming mode.
